start.name_en: Longgang City (Longgang Distribution Station — exact site not confirmed)
start.geocode_source: Nominatim q=龙港市 (Longgang City administrative-boundary centroid; a search for 龙港分输站 itself as an OSM place returned no results, and a search for 龙港市人民政府 mismatched to an unrelated Huludao, Liaoning place of the same name)

corridor_notes: Per Zhejiang Development & Reform Commission's official 14th Five-Year Plan for Coal, Petroleum and Natural Gas Development (fzggw.zj.gov.cn, 2021-07-07 — the same document already cited by a prior researcher for the neighboring Yueqing-Wenzhou pipeline), the route is described as '龙港—苍南天然气管道...由龙港延伸至苍南县灵溪镇境内，管径813mm，设计压力6.3MPa，长度约27公里' (Longgang-Cangnan Gas Pipeline, extending from Longgang to within Lingxi Town, Cangnan County, diameter 813mm, design pressure 6.3MPa, length ~27km) — the 27km figure matches GEM's LengthMergedKm=27.00 exactly, strong corroboration this is the correct project and that Lingxi Town (the Cangnan county seat) is the intended endpoint, not just 'Cangnan County' generically. A Longgang municipal gas special-plan document (关于龙港市燃气专项规划) was found via search and names 龙港分输站 (Longgang Distribution Station) as the city's current gas-source tie-in point on the Ningbo-Taizhou-Wenzhou (甬台温) trunk pipeline — plausibly this pipeline's actual start point — but that PDF is hosted on a Zhejiang government OSS bucket that fails scripts/url_verifier.py (HTTP 403, geo-blocked to non-China IPs), so it is NOT used as a ref and 龙港分输站 is not asserted as a confirmed start point; noted here for context/follow-up only.
researcher_notes: Resolution reached at city/town-seat precision only, not station-level, for the same reasons as the sibling PIDs in this batch: WebSearch budget exhausted mid-task (shared session-wide cap), and the one PDF source that names a specific Longgang-side station (龙港分输站) is geo-blocked and fails url_verifier.py, so could not be cited. Worth a follow-up search for 龙港分输站's exact coordinates once tooling allows (it is very likely the real start point, per the two independent mentions found: this planning PDF and a separate news article about 苍南末站 being located within old 龙港镇).
blockers: Station-level start precision not achieved (龙港分输站's exact location could not be confirmed via a URL that passes url_verifier.py — the one source found is geo-blocked/403). City-level (Longgang) and town-seat-level (Lingxi) coordinates used instead, backed by one verified official source (fzggw.zj.gov.cn) that corroborates the exact 27km length and names Lingxi Town as the terminus.
